result.summary: No critical breakage is visible. Two minor horizontal-carousel clipping issues make the right side look unfinished.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled gray pill at the right edge, which looks like a clipped or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the next chip shows enough text to indicate horizontal scrolling, or add right padding/fade treatment so the clipping appears intentional.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off by the viewport, including its restaurant name, without an ellipsis or clear carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card text with ellipsis and add consistent carousel spacing or a fade/scroll indicator at the right edge.
